I grow food crops on this small plot to feed my family, intercropping beans with cassava as we always do in Kagera. I will spread manure from our cattle on the soil before planting, but I cannot afford chemical fertilizer from the shop, so I will use seeds I saved from last season. We depend on the rains and work the land with our hoes, so I do not need irrigation or chemicals. My children and I will manage all the work ourselves over the season.
